create_worker_pool: create a WorkerPool instance with a function and process count for parallel execution
run_worker_pool_map: run a function on each item in an iterable using the WorkerPool run method
run_worker_pool_async: run a function asynchronously on each item in an iterable using the WorkerPool run_async method
finish_worker_pool: finish and shutdown the WorkerPool by calling close and join to clean up threads
wrap_async_exceptions: wrap a callable with AsyncWorkerExceptionsWrapper to log and re-raise exceptions in worker processes
